rss: How video game remakes tap the power of nostalgia
title: Old Games, New Fun!
story: Old video games are getting a new look! Companies are making them again, and kids can't wait to play. This means more fun for everyone who loves games.
storyBig: Video game companies are investing in remaking classic games to attract old fans and new players. This trend capitalizes on nostalgia, driving sales and generating excitement in the gaming industry.
think: Why do you think people like to play old games with new looks?
bull: There are more fun games for everyone to enjoy!
bear: It might cost more money to buy remade games than the originals.

rss: From Levi's to Primark - the fashion chains selling mended clothes
title: Cool Clothes Get Cool Patches!
story: Fashion is changing! Now, instead of buying new clothes, people are fixing and decorating old ones with patches. It's a fun way to be unique and eco-friendly!
storyBig: The fashion industry is embracing sustainability by promoting patched and visibly mended clothing. As this trend grows, it encourages consumers to buy less and recycle more, impacting how fashion brands operate.
think: How can fixing clothes instead of buying new ones help the environment?
bull: Patching clothes is a great way to show off your style!
bear: Some patched clothes might not look as neat as new ones.
